title: $Γ$-convergence and homogenisation for free discontinuity functionals with linear growth in the space of functions with bounded deformation
summary: We study the $Γ$-convergence of sequences of free discontinuity functionals with linear growth defined in the space ${\rm BD}$ of functions with bounded deformation. We prove a compactness result with respect to $Γ$-convergence and outline the main properties of the $Γ$-limits, which lead to an integral representation result. The corresponding integrands are obtained by taking limits of suitable minimisation problems on small cubes.
